summary.zh: 分析上市公司基本面、财务比率并评估估值
summary.en: Researches a listed stock with ratios and a valuation view

description.zh: 研究一只上市股票或一家公司，整理财务数据和关键比率，给出评分与估值判断，覆盖美国、全球以及印度 NSE、BSE 等地的上市公司。适合在决定是否买入、判断合理价格或快速了解一家公司时使用。需要联网获取行情与财报数据。
description.en: Researches a listed stock or company with verified financial data, key ratios, scores and a valuation view, covering US, global, NSE and BSE listings. Useful when deciding whether to buy or what a stock is worth. Needs internet access.
